# ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder

> Governed local AI / offline LLM builder for reproducible model growth, Gate v2 promotion, dataset provenance, Omnibinary memory, Arc-RAR rollback, and Synth companion roadmap horizons.

## Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/GareBear99/ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder
- Pages: https://garebear99.github.io/ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder/
- Author: Gary Doman / GareBear99

## Current verified status

- Reproducible incumbent: `arc_governed_v10_wave4` / 0.9237
- v11.3/wave5: candidate/staging only until promotion evidence regenerates cleanly
- External datasets: acquisition targets only; not bundled, not ingested, not promoted into incumbent
- Current live knowledge: self-curated ARC docs, receipts, benchmarks, operator doctrine, and ARC Language Module truth spine

## Core concepts

- Local AI
- Offline LLM builder
- GGUF-oriented candidate promotion
- Gate v2 model governance
- Regression-safe training
- Dataset manifests and quarantine
- ARC Language Module as lexical/knowledge-weight carrier
- Omnibinary as binary event/receipt memory ledger
- Arc-RAR as archive/rollback/restore bundle layer
- Time-to-space projection for receipt/event/state visualization
- ProtoSynth / Neural Synth roadmap for 4.0
- Portal-esque Synth companion mockup for 5.0
- Working Synth AI companion / AGI assistant / buildable brain lab target for 7.0

## Quick clone

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GareBear99/ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder.git
cd ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/validate_repo.py
python scripts/production_verify.py
```

## Important boundary

Do not describe this repo as a finished frontier model. It is a governed local AI build-and-memory system with a reproducible incumbent, candidate isolation, dataset acquisition roadmap, and long-horizon Synth companion roadmap.
